messages:
anya: Putting up an econ-driven pinning + deprecation playbook for discussion. TL;DR: pin by cost delta + adoption %, soft-deprecate >90 days, migration credits. Thoughts?

mike: love the framing. can you share the launch gates? what metrics do we require to unpin? :eyes:

anya: thinking gates: latency regression <2%, p95 <= baseline+30ms, 7-day mismatch rate <0.5%, cost delta >20% favors new model. example rules:
```
{
  "unpin_if": {
    "latency_regression_pct": 2,
    "adoption_pct": 25,
    "cost_delta_pct": 20
  }
}
```

liz: where do benchmarks live? we should pin to bench slices (chat, embed, rerank) and include language/locale coverage. also need customer opt-in timeline (30/60/90d).

julio: ops/customer ask: enterprise customers need 120d grace and contract clause. recommend soft-mode: dual-serve canary for 60d with explicit opt-in.

catalina: SRE/console note: need rollout plan with automatic fallback and per-tenant flags. add runbook steps for rollback + communication template. also document token-cost impact per-route.

anya: agree. propose two lanes: conservative (enterprise) 120d + concierge; standard 60d + auto-fallback; aggressive 30d for low-risk models with small user surface. migration credit sketch: 3 months credits for pinned tenants that accept migration assistance.

mike: i'll formalize acceptance checklist. suggested items: bench slices defined, smoke tests, load test at 2x baseline QPS, cost simulation report, comm plan, legal signoff for credits.

anya: owners: mike -> acceptance checklist & load tests, liz -> benchmark matrix and datasets, julio -> customer comms & credits, catalina -> SLOs + rollback runbook. i'll own final playbook and the rollout policy docs.

ops-bot: New doc created: <https://console.redwood.dev/docs/pinning-playbook|pinning-playbook draft> by anya :spiral_note_pad:

liz: :thumbsup: i'll start the bench matrix today. ping me with datasets and sample tenant telemetry.

julio: adding a note re: contractual gracepath here — legal needs to approve the 120d clause before we publish any customer-facing timeline.

mike: next sync Wednesday 10am PT? :calendar:

anya: yes, added to calendar and invited owners. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
